queries.title: Filtriranje (broj proizvoda u prolazu 24)
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS n FROM instacart.products WHERE aisle_id = 24

queries.title: Spajanje 2 tablice + grupiranje po odjelu
queries.sql: SELECT d.department, count() AS n FROM instacart.products p INNER JOIN instacart.departments d ON p.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department ORDER BY n DESC

queries.title: Filtriranje narudžbi (nedjelja, 9-15 h)
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS n FROM instacart.orders WHERE order_dow = 0 AND order_hour_of_day BETWEEN 9 AND 15

queries.title: Grupiranje po danu i satu (168 grupa)
queries.sql: SELECT order_dow, order_hour_of_day, count() AS n FROM instacart.orders GROUP BY order_dow, order_hour_of_day ORDER BY order_dow, order_hour_of_day

queries.title: Spajanje 3 tablice + grupiranje po prolazu
queries.sql: SELECT a.aisle, count() AS n FROM instacart.order_products_train t INNER JOIN instacart.products p ON t.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN instacart.aisles a ON p.aisle_id = a.aisle_id GROUP BY a.aisle ORDER BY n DESC

queries.title: Filtriranje nad 32,4 M zapisa (ponovljene kupnje)
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS n FROM instacart.order_products_prior WHERE reordered = 1

queries.title: Grupiranje nad 32,4 M zapisa (top 20 proizvoda)
queries.sql: SELECT product_id, count() AS n FROM instacart.order_products_prior GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY n DESC, product_id LIMIT 20

queries.title: Spajanje 3 tablice nad 32,4 M zapisa (po odjelu)
queries.sql: SELECT d.department, count() AS n FROM instacart.order_products_prior opp INNER JOIN instacart.products p ON opp.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN instacart.departments d ON p.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department ORDER BY n DESC

queries.title: Spajanje 4 tablice nad 32,4 M zapisa (odjel x dan)
queries.sql: SELECT d.department, o.order_dow, count() AS n FROM instacart.order_products_prior opp INNER JOIN instacart.orders o ON opp.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN instacart.products p ON opp.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN instacart.departments d ON p.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department, o.order_dow ORDER BY d.department, o.order_dow

scalability.title: Isti upit nad rastućim podskupom tablice order_products_prior (granica po order_id)
scalability.template: SELECT product_id, count() AS n FROM instacart.order_products_prior {where} GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY n DESC, product_id LIMIT 20
scalability.rows_template: SELECT count() AS n FROM instacart.order_products_prior {where}
